description: Evaluate stage final artifact (verdict tool arguments). The verdict values are the SMG route keys exactly: the workflow graph routes evaluate with { proceed: _next-flow, reject: intake }. Clarifying questions happen in-execution via the question tool — no send-back-for-clarification route exists.

verdict.description: Routing decision: 'proceed' advances to the next flow, 'reject' re-runs intake. No other values exist.

summary.description: Brief overall assessment, shown in run summaries and the gate review screen.

content.description: Full evaluation report (markdown: risks, findings, strengths). Optional; the .turbojet/output.md contents fit here.

rationale.description: Required in substance when verdict is 'proceed': why the requirements are clear and well-defined enough to advance.

unresolved.description: Required in substance when verdict is 'reject': the unresolved items that block proceeding, each with why it blocks.
